(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not state whether this size is before or after the I.Z.B.P. plating; accumulated plating thickness can eliminate the intended clearance and prevent assembly. The designer should add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate machining size to allow for the coating thickness."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note such as 'H7 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify an undersize machining dimension that accounts for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
